intro: SystemSerenity also takes on a small number of fixed-price projects for small businesses: the same systems thinking, scoped so you know the cost up front.

offers.title: Small-business websites
offers.summary: A one-page site ($399) or a 5-page site ($599), delivered in 7 days, with no CMS to maintain.
includes: One page, or 5 pages covering your services, about, reviews, service area and contact
Click-to-call, contact form, service area and Google Business Profile link
Search-friendly structured data for local businesses
Hosting on Cloudflare at no monthly hosting cost; your own .com at cost, registered in your name
First client: the site is free in exchange for featuring it in this portfolio (until claimed)

addon.title: Optional maintenance
addon.text: Content edits (up to 2 hours a month), uptime monitoring, backups and a monthly report. Cancel with 30 days' notice.

offers.title: Workflow & AI automation setup
offers.summary: Fixed-fee automation built in your own accounts, handed over with a runbook and 30 days of email support.
includes: Renewal and follow-up reminder system (Sheets, Calendar, email drafts): $600
Lead intake to sheet or CRM with an instant acknowledgment: $600

addon.title: How it works
addon.text: A 20-minute discovery call, a written scope with acceptance criteria, 50% deposit and 50% on acceptance. Built in your own accounts; you keep control of any credentials.
